verdict.rationale: Official client SDKs are a fair question for a media relay service, so the axis applies. The evidence covers relay creation, scoped tokens and draft-16 session authentication, but never mentions official web, iOS or Android SDKs or a shared session and track model across them. Community reports of browser demos and mobile-browser playback are not evidence of first-party platform SDKs.

support.subject: As a developer, official client SDKs cover web, iOS, and Android with the same session and track model, so one backend serves every platform
